page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-32 is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8581C processor. This instance features 32 vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. It is equipped with 248.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.75 GB of RAM per core. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities in specific processing tasks. The server demonstrates strong single-core Geekbench scores of 1933.0 and strong multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 187.69 GB/sec. It also shows strong performance in image processing, text processing, and Passmark CPU physics tests. For web workloads, static web serving throughput is strong at 51.15 GB/sec. In contrast, multi-core Geekbench and Passmark CPU scores fall into the average tier.

The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE and AMX_INT8). These hardware accelerators contribute to top-tier text generation speeds of 421.19 tokens/sec for small 135M parameter LLM models, though performance drops to a poor 2.38 tokens/sec for large 70B parameter models. Given its memory-to-vCPU ratio and lack of local storage, this server is suited for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, static web serving, and lightweight machine learning inference.
